ns2:course.label: Social Justice Leadership
ns2:course.description: Leadership operates in the context of broader society; a society characterized by rampant inequalities and various forms of injustice. This course allows students to apply social justice concepts to their ongoing leadership development toward solving complex social problems. Frameworks rooted in social identity, intersectionality, and positionality will be used, alongside knowledge gained from current and prior leadership coursework and co-curricular involvement. Special focus will be given to preparing students for LEAD 340. Approved for Letter and S/U grading.
